name: Do S na Kare to Himitsu no Keiyaku Kekkon
original_name: ドSな彼と秘密の契約結婚
source: You work at a big enterprise as a contract worker. However, you are fired suddenly. Moreover, you lose your house cause of owner's reason. You are in a maze, and then you meet your two childhood friends again. Two guys comfort you with each way and propose one solution. Which man do you choose? What will happen to you? You will fall in love with sadistic man... Please enjoy love romance with two sadistic type guys!
